message: So, there's a little storm brewing, and you know that one friend who suddenly becomes a weather expert? 😅 I always find it helpful to have a few calm and practical resources on hand for those moments. I stumbled upon a great spot that walks you through what to do during tornadoes. It’s not about panicking, but rather being prepared in a sensible way. After all, a little knowledge goes a long way in keeping our loved ones safe. What’s your go-to tip when the weather gets a bit dicey?
